originalTitle: Archer Aviation shares jump nearly 10% on deal to acquire Boeing’s Wisk, two other units
simplifiedContent: Archer Aviation's stock price went up by almost 10% because the company is buying three units from Boeing, including Wisk Aero. This purchase will give Archer access to Boeing's technology for autonomous flights and defense. As part of the deal, Boeing will own a significant part of Archer and have a say in the company's decisions. This is a big move for Archer because it will start making money right away from one of the units it's buying, called Insitu, which makes drones and is already profitable. Overall, the deal seems to be a positive development for Archer Aviation, which is why its stock price increased.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: Indian stocks started the week in a calm manner because investors are worried about what's happening globally. However, companies' good financial results from the first quarter of the year helped balance out these concerns. There are also worries about tensions between countries that are affecting investor mood. Analysts are now paying attention to US employment data and inflation numbers to figure out what will happen with interest rates. This will help decide what happens in the stock market on Tuesday.

originalTitle: Milky Mist Dairy Food mops up ₹465 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO
simplifiedContent: Milky Mist Dairy Food, a company that is going to sell its shares to the public, has already raised ₹465.29 crore from big investors before its shares are available to everyone. This is happening before the company's Initial Public Offering (IPO), which starts on August 11 and ends on August 13. The company is selling its shares for ₹133-140 each, and you need to invest at least ₹14,980 to buy them. The company hopes to list its shares on the stock market on August 18. This is important because it shows that big investors are interested in buying the company's shares, which might make the IPO more attractive to other investors.

originalTitle: Zen Technologies shares to be in focus on Tuesday after company secures  ₹295 crore defence order
simplifiedContent: Zen Technologies, a company that makes products for the military, just got a big order worth ₹295 crore from the government. This is a significant deal that will help the company make more money in the future. The company now has a total of ₹1,239.02 crore in orders that it needs to fulfill, which is a good sign for its business. This news might make investors pay attention to the company's stock on Tuesday. The company is also working on new products and training programs for the Air Force, which could help its revenue grow, even though it didn't make as much profit as it had hoped for this quarter.

originalTitle: Intel plans $15 billion share sale as turnaround rally lifts stock
simplifiedContent: Intel, a big technology company, is planning to sell $15 billion worth of its shares. The company is using this money to invest in new facilities and improve its ability to make advanced chips. This is part of Intel's plan to compete with other leading companies in the industry, like TSMC, in making chips for other businesses. Intel's stock price has been going up lately, which is why the company is able to sell its shares now. By investing in new facilities and technologies, Intel hopes to become more competitive in the market.

originalTitle: This new-age tech stock hits over 4-year high, recovers 70% from March lows. Are you holding it?
simplifiedContent: The stock price of One97 Communications, the company that owns Paytm, has gone up by 10% to ₹1,598. This is a 4-year high for the company, and it's recovered 70% from its low point in March. The reason for the increase is that a company called Bernstein thinks the stock will do well and has set a higher target price of ₹2,200. Bernstein believes this is because One97 Communications might benefit from fees related to a payment system called UPI. This news matters because it could be a good sign for investors who already own the stock, and might make others consider buying it.
